title: Travel concierge catalog
description: The components a travel agent may render. Each one declares three things: how it is written in A2UI Express, what the transpiler must emit for it, and its modality gates. The grammar handed to the model is generated from this file — so a component that isn't here has no syntax, and a line that names it cannot parse.
instructions: Surfaces are summoned by a conversation and dismissed by it. Render one decision, never a page. Do not render a surface that only repeats what you just said — if it fits in a sentence, it is a sentence. Reach for a surface when there are more than three things to compare, when the user must verify something you cannot summarise, when a value needs precision, or when a commit is irreversible.

Column.description: Vertical stack. Every surface has exactly one Column with id 'root'. Never written in Express — the transpiler creates it.

Heading.description: A short label above a list. Two or three words plus context. Never a sentence.

OptionCards.description: The workhorse: selectable cards for flights, hotels, times. `detail` is whatever distinguishes them — departure and arrival times for a flight, a neighbourhood for a hotel. The user picks one by tapping or by saying 'the second one'.

head: action
express.example:
cards pick_flight
- TAP Air Portugal | 06:15–09:05 | EUR 189 | direct

SeatMap.description: A cabin layout. Speech cannot carry a seat map — a spoken description would be invented detail the traveller then acts on.

PaymentConfirm.description: Money leaves the account when this is confirmed. Use for the final booking step only.

head: action
express.example: confirm pay_now | easyJet · Fri 11:40 to Lisbon | EUR 212.00 | Visa ending 4417

SensitiveList.description: Passport numbers, card digits, frequent-flyer numbers, home address. Renders in full on screen and is never spoken aloud.

Status.description: A live line that changes after you have stopped talking — 'seat 14C held', 'gate posted'. Never use it to repeat something you already said.

examples.spoken: Three come in under three hundred — the cheapest is the early one out.
examples.express:
heading Lisbon · Fri 14 – Sun 16
cards pick_flight
- TAP Air Portugal | 06:15–09:05 | EUR 189 | direct
- easyJet | 11:40–14:25 | EUR 212 | direct
- Ryanair | 19:05–21:50 | EUR 244 | 1 stop
note Prices held for 20 minutes

examples.spoken: That's two hundred and twelve euros for the easyJet. Say confirm and I'll book it.
examples.express: confirm pay_now | easyJet · Fri 11:40 to Lisbon | EUR 212.00 | Visa ending 4417
